newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade quiet, prices firm.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade quiet, prices firm.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume eased on Thursday to 344 kilos from 565 kilos on Wednesday in quiet trade.
Prices rose and traders were sidelined expecting future price falls, dealers said.
Gold closed at $345.00 an ounce and 1,298,000 lira per gram, compared to $343.00 and 1,292,000 on Wednesday.
Dealers said gold firmed with international levels, but bearish sentiment persisted.
The bulk of the day's trade -- 323 kilos -- was conducted in the morning session, and 81.4 percent of turnover was in lira terms.
